records.jp: お散歩、いいね！　行く行く！
records.en_original: A walk? That sounds nice. Of course I'll go!
records.en_auxiliary: A walk? That sounds nice. Of course I'll go!
records.en: A walk sounds nice! I'll go, I'll go!

records.jp: やった～！　それじゃあまずはね……
records.en_original: Yay! Then let's head over to...
records.en_auxiliary: Yay! Then let's head over to...
records.en: Yay! Then first...

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、あっちの空見て。お～っきな入道雲！
records.en_original: Look over there, Ao! There's a huuuuge cloud!
records.en_auxiliary: Look over there, Ao! There's a huuuuge cloud!
records.en: Ao-chan, look over there! That cloud is huuuge!

records.jp: わっ、ほんとだ
records.en_original: Oh, you're right.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, you're right.
records.en: Wow, you're right.

records.jp: 夏って感じだねぇ。<CR>あっ、あっちの雲も面白い形してる
records.en_original: Really feels like summer, huh? Ooh, that one's shaped funny!
records.en_auxiliary: Really feels like summer, huh? Ooh, that one's shaped funny!
records.en: It really feels like summer.<CR>Ah, that cloud over there has an interesting shape too.

records.jp: あれは……堕天使の片翼と呼ばれる雲だね！<CR>罪を犯した天使が、空から追放される時に現れる……
records.en_original: Oh yeah, they call those one-winged angels. They say they only show up when an angel falls from heaven...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh yeah, they call those one-winged angels. They say they only show up when an angel falls from heaven...
records.en: That one is called the Fallen Angel's Wing cloud!<CR>It appears when an angel who sinned is cast out of the sky...

records.jp: そうだったんだ！？　愛央ちゃん物知りだねぇ
records.en_original: Really?! You're sure know a lot, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: Really?! You're sure know a lot, Ao.
records.en: I didn't know that!? You know so much, Ao-chan.

records.jp: まぁ冗談なんだけどね！
records.en_original: I'm totally kidding.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm totally kidding.
records.en: Well, it was just a joke.

records.jp: え……ええーっ！？　また冗談だったの！？
records.en_original: Wh-what?! You tricked me again?!
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what?! You tricked me again?!
records.en: Wha—whaaat!? That was a joke too!?

records.jp: あはは。ごめんごめん。<CR>素直に信じる陽桜莉さんが可愛くて、つい
records.en_original: Ahaha, I'm sorry! It's just cute how trusting you are.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha, I'm sorry! It's just cute how trusting you are.
records.en: Ahaha, sorry, sorry.<CR>You're just so cute when you trust me so easily, Hiori-san.

records.jp: か、可愛くなんてないよー。<CR>もー、愛央ちゃんってば……
records.en_original: Wh-what do you mean cute! Jeez, there you go again!
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what do you mean cute! Jeez, there you go again!
records.en: I-I'm not cute at all.<CR>Geez, Ao-chan...

records.jp: そこは冗談じゃないんだけどなぁ……。それに私、<CR>陽桜莉さんのこと、素敵だなーって思ってるし
records.en_original: I'm not joking about that part though! I think you're great.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm not joking about that part though! I think you're great.
records.en: I wasn't joking about that part, though... And besides,<CR>I do think you're wonderful, Hiori-san.

records.jp: えっ？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: この間、一緒に中庭を掃除した時に思ったんだ。<CR>いろんなことを率先してやって、まっすぐな人だなって
records.en_original: Ever since we cleaned the courtyard together, I've been thinking about what a sincere person and hard worker you are.
records.en_auxiliary: Ever since we cleaned the courtyard together, I've been thinking about what a sincere person and hard worker you are.
records.en: I thought so when we cleaned the courtyard together the other day.<CR>That you take the initiative in all kinds of things, and that you're a straightforward person.

records.jp: 私も……<CR>陽桜莉さんみたいになりたいなーなんて……
records.en_original: It...kinda made me want to be like you, y'know?
records.en_auxiliary: It...kinda made me want to be like you, y'know?
records.en: I also...<CR>kind of wish I could be more like you, Hiori-san...

records.jp: ……？　陽桜莉さん？
records.en_original: Um... Hiori?
records.en_auxiliary: Um... Hiori?
records.en: ...? Hiori-san?

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんにそういうふうに言ってもらえるのは<CR>嬉しいけど……私、そんな偉い人間じゃないよ
records.en_original: I'm flattered that you'd say so, but... I don't think I'm such a great person.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm flattered that you'd say so, but... I don't think I'm such a great person.
records.en: I'm happy that you'd say that kind of thing to me,<CR>Ao-chan... but I'm not such an admirable person.

records.jp: 昔、言われたことがあるんだ。<CR>おせっかいだって
records.en_original: People used to always say I was a busybody.
records.en_auxiliary: People used to always say I was a busybody.
records.en: People told me that once before.<CR>That I was meddlesome.

records.jp: ……小さいころ、良かれと思って学校の花壇に<CR>水を撒いてたことがあったんだ
records.en_original: When I was little, I used to water the garden at school because I thought it would be helpful.
records.en_auxiliary: When I was little, I used to water the garden at school because I thought it would be helpful.
records.en: ...When I was little, I used to water the flowerbeds at school<CR>because I thought it was the right thing to do.

records.jp: 綺麗に咲いたらみんな喜んでくれるかなって。<CR>先生もほめてくれたから、毎日続けることにした
records.en_original: I thought everyone would be happy if the flowers bloomed. When my teacher praised me for it, I started doing it every day.
records.en_auxiliary: I thought everyone would be happy if the flowers bloomed. When my teacher praised me for it, I started doing it every day.
records.en: I thought everyone would be happy if they bloomed beautifully.<CR>And my teacher praised me, so I decided to keep doing it every day.

records.jp: そのうち先生が毎日大変でしょ、もういいよって<CR>言うようになって……
records.en_original: Then one day, she told me I didn't have to work so hard. That I didn't need to keep doing it.
records.en_auxiliary: Then one day, she told me I didn't have to work so hard. That I didn't need to keep doing it.
records.en: Before long, my teacher started saying it must be hard to do it every day,<CR>and that I didn't have to anymore...

records.jp: けど、大丈夫です、続けますって<CR>いっそう水やりに励んだ
records.en_original: But I told her I didn't mind, and that I wanted to keep watering them. So I did.
records.en_auxiliary: But I told her I didn't mind, and that I wanted to keep watering them. So I did.
records.en: But I said it was fine, that I'd keep doing it,<CR>and I devoted myself to watering them even more.

records.jp: ……そしたら、怒られちゃった。<CR>水、やりすぎで枯れそうだったんだって
records.en_original: ...Then I got in trouble. Apparently the flowers were dying because I was over-watering them.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Then I got in trouble. Apparently the flowers were dying because I was over-watering them.
records.en: ...And then I got scolded.<CR>They said I'd watered them so much they were starting to wither.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さん……
records.en_original: Hiori...
records.en_auxiliary: Hiori...
records.en: Hiori-san...

records.jp: ……たぶん、こういう性格だったから、私、<CR>お母さんの気持ちにも気付けなかったんだと思う
records.en_original: I think it's because I'm like this that I never noticed how Mom felt.
records.en_auxiliary: I think it's because I'm like this that I never noticed how Mom felt.
records.en: ...I think it's because I'm this kind of person<CR>that I couldn't even notice how Mom felt.

records.jp: …………。ココロトープでのこと？
records.en_original: Are you talking about what happened in the Heartscape?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you talking about what happened in the Heartscape?
records.en: ............In the Heartscape?

records.jp: うん。お母さんは片親で私たちを育てることが、<CR>すごく辛かったのに……私、想像もしてなくて
records.en_original: Yeah. I'm sure it was hard raising us as a single mother, but...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. I'm sure it was hard raising us as a single mother, but...
records.en: Yeah. Mom raised us all on her own,<CR>and it must've been so hard... I never even thought about that.

records.jp: たぶん、物事の表の部分しか見られてないんだ。<CR>私……
records.en_original: I never even considered her feelings. I guess I just take thing at their face value...
records.en_auxiliary: I never even considered her feelings. I guess I just take thing at their face value...
records.en: I think maybe I can only see the surface of things.<CR>I...

records.jp: それでも、きっと誰かのためになるって思って<CR>いろいろ手を出してるけど……
records.en_original: Even still I can't help but meddle when I think it'll help somebody...
records.en_auxiliary: Even still I can't help but meddle when I think it'll help somebody...
records.en: Even so, I can't help getting involved<CR>when I think it'll help someone...

records.jp: このまま続けて、いいのかな……
records.en_original: I wonder if I need to change...
records.en_auxiliary: I wonder if I need to change...
records.en: I wonder if it's okay to keep doing this...

records.jp: あっ！　ご、ごめん！<CR>急にこんなこと言われても困っちゃうよね
records.en_original: Ah, I'm sorry! I didn't mean to dump all this on you.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, I'm sorry! I didn't mean to dump all this on you.
records.en: Ah! S-sorry!<CR>It's awkward to suddenly say something like that to you, isn't it?

records.jp: 困ったりなんかしないよ。<CR>陽桜莉さんの気持ち、聞かせてもらって嬉しい
records.en_original: There's nothing to be sorry about. I'm glad you feel like you can talk to me about stuff.
records.en_auxiliary: There's nothing to be sorry about. I'm glad you feel like you can talk to me about stuff.
records.en: It isn't awkward at all.<CR>I'm glad you let me hear how you feel, Hiori-san.

records.jp: ……ありがと。愛央ちゃん
records.en_original: Thanks, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks, Ao.
records.en: ...Thanks, Ao-chan.

records.jp: 歩いてたら、喉渇いてきたね。<CR>次は作業室の方に行ってみようか
records.en_original: You know what? All this walking is making me thirsty. Let's head over to the work room next.
records.en_auxiliary: You know what? All this walking is making me thirsty. Let's head over to the work room next.
records.en: Walking around has made me thirsty.<CR>Shall we head toward the workroom next?

records.jp: （……陽桜莉さん、普段は明るくて元気だけど、<CR>あんな悩みがあったんだ）
records.en_original: (Hiori is always so bright and cheerful. I never would have guessed that she had so much on her mind.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Hiori is always so bright and cheerful. I never would have guessed that she had so much on her mind.)
records.en: (...Hiori-san is usually bright and cheerful,<CR>but she had worries like that.)

records.jp: （私も、陽桜莉さんの表面しか見てなかった、のかな。<CR>……なにか、力になれたらいいんだけどな）
records.en_original: (Maybe I should stop taking things at face value too... Is there something I can do to help her?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Maybe I should stop taking things at face value too... Is there something I can do to help her?)
records.en: (Maybe I too had only been seeing Hiori-san's surface.<CR>...I wish I could do something to help her.)

records.jp: 交流により新たな工作物を思いつきました。<CR>「<CLGR>謎味ジュース<CLNR>」のメモリーを手に入れました
records.en_original: A new crafting idea pops into your head after your exchange.<CR>You acquired the <CLGR>Mystery Juice<CLNR> memory.
records.en_auxiliary: A new crafting idea pops into your head after your exchange.<CR>You acquired the <CLGR>Mystery Juice<CLNR> memory.
records.en: A new crafting idea came to you through your bond.<CR>You obtained the <CLGR>Mystery Juice<CLNR> memory.
